## 1. Data Import and Validation

This section loads the discovery data and validates input files.

```{r data_import, message=FALSE}
# ── Discovery ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

discovery_path <- params$discovery_input
if (is.null(discovery_path)) {
  stop("Discovery file parameter is NULL")
}

if (!file.exists(discovery_path)) stop("Discovery file not found: ", discovery_path)

# Read text first so numeric-looking identifiers retain their exact spelling.
discovery_df <- read_tsv(discovery_path, show_col_types = FALSE,
                         col_types = cols(.default = col_character()), na = "", trim_ws = FALSE)

# The columns of discovery.tab are lowercase (gene, trait, position, pattern, ffgn, ...).
# Only the structural keys are renamed to the CamelCase names this report joins on (Gene,
# Position). Other columns, including the residue-diversity `pattern` code,
# keep their lowercase names.
.disc_keymap <- c(Gene = "gene", Position = "position")
for (.new in names(.disc_keymap)) {
  .old <- .disc_keymap[[.new]]
  if (.old %in% names(discovery_df) && !(.new %in% names(discovery_df))) {
    names(discovery_df)[names(discovery_df) == .old] <- .new
  }
}

cat(sprintf("Loaded discovery file: %s\n", basename(discovery_path)))

# ── Background ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

background_path <- params$background_input
if (is.null(background_path) || !file.exists(background_path)) {
  stop("Background file not found: ", background_path)
}

# Canonical CT background_genes.output is a headerless, one-gene-per-line list.
# Accept a single Gene/gene header for legacy callers explicitly.
background_genes <- trimws(readLines(background_path, warn = FALSE))
background_genes <- background_genes[nzchar(background_genes)]
if (length(background_genes) && background_genes[1] %in% c("Gene", "gene")) {
  background_genes <- background_genes[-1]
}
if (any(grepl("\\t", background_genes))) stop("Background input must be a one-column gene list")
background_genes <- unique(background_genes)
background_df <- tibble(Gene = background_genes)
cat(sprintf("Loaded background file: %s\n", basename(background_path)))
cat(sprintf("Total genes in background: %s\n", format(nrow(background_df), big.mark = ",")))


# ── Required columns ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

required_cols <- c("Gene", "Position", "pattern")
missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(discovery_df))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required columns in discovery: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
}
if (anyNA(discovery_df$Gene) || any(!nzchar(discovery_df$Gene))) stop("Discovery has missing gene identifiers")
position <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(discovery_df$Position))
if (any(!is.finite(position) | position < 0 | position != floor(position))) stop("Discovery positions must be nonnegative integers")
discovery_df$Position <- position
if (anyNA(discovery_df$pattern) || any(!discovery_df$pattern %in% as.character(1:4))) stop("Discovery patterns must be 1, 2, 3 or 4")
n_positions <- nrow(distinct(discovery_df, Gene, Position))
cat(sprintf("Discovery rows: %s; unique alignment positions: %s\n", nrow(discovery_df), n_positions))
if (!nrow(discovery_df)) cat("No CAAS discoveries were found. Downstream analyses can continue.\n")

```

## 2. Pattern-Based Analysis

Patterns describe foreground/background residue diversity: 1 = one/one, 2 = one/many,
3 = many/one and 4 = many/many. Counts of discovery rows include repeated positions
under different hypotheses. Unique positions are counted by `(Gene, Position)`;
a position appearing in different patterns contributes to each of those patterns.
These are discovery summaries, before downstream post-processing or significance filtering.

```{r pattern_analysis}
# One position can occur under several hypotheses or patterns. Per-pattern
# unique-position counts overlap and must not be summed into a global total.
pattern_summary <- discovery_df %>%
  group_by(pattern) %>%
  summarize(Discovery_rows = n(), Unique_positions = n_distinct(Gene, Position), .groups = "drop")

cat("\nPattern Distribution:\n")
print(kable(pattern_summary, format.args = list(big.mark = ",")))

p_pattern <- ggplot(pattern_summary, aes(x = factor(pattern), y = Discovery_rows, fill = factor(pattern))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  report_theme() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pattern_palette, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "CAAS Pattern Distribution",
    x = "Pattern",
    y = "Discovery rows"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(l = 20, r = 20)),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 12)),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0, margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 6)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "darkgray", size = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_pattern)
```
